name: RockDesk
oneLiner: 面向开发者和 AI Agent 的 P2P 远程设备工具：一个 ID 管所有机器，远程桌面、终端、文件、端口转发和 VPN 一体，自带 rds 命令行和 Agent Skill/MCP
oneLinerEn: A P2P remote-device tool for developers and AI agents: one ID for every machine, combining remote desktop, terminal, files, port forwarding and VPN, with an rds CLI and an Agent Skill/MCP server.
